Perhaps Palestinianism Is a Major Symptom of NPC Syndrome

26 Jun 2026 by Sufian M′Barki

As I keep existing in this delirious society, I witness more and more people spouting their antisemitic vitriol in spaces where it's beyond inappropriate, unwarranted, and downright embarrassing.

I love coining terms as long as they are not gimmicky, and this phenomenon is the perfect example of what I would like to start calling Knee-Jerk Antisemitism.

NPC Syndrome is slang for people who lack independent thought, introspection, or original decision-making. Propally death cultism (or Palestinianism for short) is one major symptom of NPC Syndrome.

But when you shart out your complete nonsense in a public forum where a Zionist is asking a question about Winx Club roleplaying with original characters, perhaps it truly is time to start considering whether you want to keep spending your miserable life wasting any more oxygen, or seek professional help as soon as bloody possible.

Knee-Jerk Antisemitism is quite amusing, apart from always making me feel absolutely tilted of course, because you quite literally always see the exact same patterns, talking points, hate speech, and so on.

At this point, scientists need to study why propally death cultists actually behave like shitty Python scripts, designed to fire off like blunt early 2000s software upon seeing vague preset markers anywhere: an Israeli flag in your nickname, or an openly Zionist profile bio, a symbol of Judaism, or any Hebrew word, perhaps even being brown-skinned at this point or having the color blue anywhere on your profile (who knows).

I have decided to extract every single repetitive talking point in a short list. Normally, this is the part where I would say, "Have fun," but I don't think degenerates spilling acid into our eyes is entertaining:

PhraseComment
Dropping bombs on children's heads, or any slight variation.This is a classic.
Apartheid Zionist xenophobes, or any slight variation.As a brown, non-Jewish, secular Arabian, I wonder why Israelis and Jews have always been so amazing and hospitable towards me then.
Baby-killers, killing women and children, or any slight variation.I don't even know at this point.
$7000 per post btw.I fucking wish.
192 expulsions.I was not aware inflammatory neo-Nazi memes were back in fashion?
Gaza is an open-air prison, Israeli occupation, or any slight variation.My foot.

One of my favorite phrases when it comes to Palestinianism is Schrödinger's Gaza. Both destroyed and genocided, and thriving in a brand new, atrocious "Nova Restaurant"[3] (the equivalent of calling your Green Deli "Holocaust Deli"). Both an open-air prison, and a "culturally rich haven" that you can allegedly access via a mere boat (you can't, unless you want to be arrested for breaking a military blockade; and it is not an open-air prison).

Make up your mind. Are children and women starving, or are they dead? Are they freezing, or are they having fun on the nice, sunny beaches of the Gaza Strip?

Perhaps the solutiuon to the Schrödinger's Gaza problem is to observe Gaza and see exactly what's happening:

  • What's "destroyed" is terrorist infrastructure, tunnels, weapon caches, bases, headquarters, and so on. I wouldn't call it "destruction" in the sense of mindless chaos, if its goal is to purge the Earth from terrorist scum[1].
  • Nobody can physically freeze in the Middle East unless we have found ourselves in a global Ice Age.
  • And nobody is starving if tons upon tons of food, medications, and other supplies are shipped by the IDF straight into Gaza for non-combattants[2].

What a bleeding shame. And here I thought going into my adult years that my only concerns would be making money and deciding how to fulfill my own dreams. Instead, we get to experience the 1920s - just transposed by 100 years.

Sufian M'Barki
